notes: Subnet mapping: the overlay no longer carries a customer's LAN range, so a technician on 192.168.1.0/24 can reach a customer on 192.168.1.0/24. Each advertised LAN gets a prefix of its own and the gateway rewrites between the two, host part preserved. Rules are still written about the real address. Also fixes a rule about one machine being enforced as a rule about the whole subnet.
